name: 125. Encrypted reasoning provider switch (same model family, different hosting provider)
description: Regression for a conversation whose encrypted reasoning tokens were minted by one provider and are replayed to a different provider hosting the same model family, the way a user switching Codex from bedrock/openai.gpt-5.6-luna to bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-luna does. Every such token is bound to the identity that minted it (OpenAI org and item id, AWS account, region and surface, Anthropic model binding, Gemini model), so the second provider refuses it with HTTP 400 in its own wording: Mantle 'invalid encrypted reasoning', Bedrock 'created for a different account or model' or 'cannot be used in a different region', xAI 'Could not decrypt the provided encrypted_content', Vertex 'Thought signature is not valid', Anthropic 'Invalid `signature` in `thinking` block'. Bifrost must treat any 400 that names a reasoning token as a fail-soft trigger, strip the tokens once and retry, so the turn completes with summaries only instead of failing. Each pair has a producer that captures real output (a missing token fails the producer loudly) and two consumers that replay the same history on the other provider, unary and streaming, and require a completed response with assistant text and no refusal wording. Gemini pairs force a get_time tool call because Gemini mints a thought signature only alongside a function call; the consumers answer the call and set tool_choice none so the reply is text. Pairs: A1 (GPT): bedrock/us.openai.gpt-5.6-luna -> bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-luna; A2 (GPT): bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-luna -> bedrock/us.openai.gpt-5.6-luna; A3 (GPT): openai/gpt-5.6-luna -> azure/gpt-5.6-luna; A4 (GPT): azure/gpt-5.6-luna -> openai/gpt-5.6-luna; A5 (GPT): azure/gpt-5.6-luna -> bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-luna; A6 (GPT): openai/gpt-5.6-luna -> bedrock/us.openai.gpt-5.6-luna; B1 (Claude): anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 -> vertex/claude-sonnet-4-6; B2 (Claude): vertex/claude-sonnet-4-6 -> anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6; B3 (Claude): anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 -> bedrock/global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; B4 (Claude): bedrock/global.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 -> bedrock_mantle/anthropic.claude-opus-4-8; B5 (Claude): bedrock_mantle/anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 -> anthropic/claude-opus-4-8; C1 (Gemini): gemini/gemini-3.7-flash -> vertex/gemini-3.7-flash; C2 (Gemini): vertex/gemini-3.7-flash -> gemini/gemini-3.7-flash; D1 (Grok): xai/grok-4-0709 -> bedrock/us.xai.grok-4.6; E1 (cross-family): openai/gpt-5.6-luna -> anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6. Requires credentials for openai, azure (gpt-5.6-luna deployment), anthropic, vertex (Claude and Gemini), gemini, xai, bedrock and bedrock_mantle. Run with FEATURE="encrypted reasoning provider switch".

item.name: bedrock/us.openai.gpt-5.6-luna capture encrypted reasoning (pair A1, GPT producer) - encrypted reasoning provider switch

exec: pm.test('pair A1 producer mints real encrypted reasoning for replay on another provider', function () {
pm.expect(reasoning, 'producer returned no encrypted reasoning, so there is nothing for the consumers to replay: ' + body).to.not.be.empty;

var history = [{role: 'user', content: "Find the smallest positive integer that leaves remainder 2 when divided by 3, remainder 3 when divided by 5, and remainder 2 when divided by 7. Give only the integer."}];
// Every tool call has to be answered before the next user turn, or the replay is rejected for a reason unrelated to the token.

body.raw: {"model":"bedrock/us.openai.gpt-5.6-luna","store":false,"max_output_tokens":2048,"reasoning":{"effort":"low"},"include":["reasoning.encrypted_content"],"input":[{"role":"user","content":"Find the smallest positive integer that leaves remainder 2 when divided by 3, remainder 3 when divided by 5, and remainder 2 when divided by 7. Give only the integer."}]}

item.name: bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-luna unary replay (pair A1, GPT consumer) - encrypted reasoning provider switch

exec: pm.test('pair A1 consumer completes after replaying a token minted elsewhere', function () {
// Scan the payload without extra_fields: raw_response echoes the provider wire (e.g. Bedrock reasoningContent) and is not a refusal.
try { var scanObj = JSON.parse(body); delete scanObj.extra_fields; scanned = JSON.stringify(scanObj); } catch (e) { scanned = body; }
pm.expect(lower, 'an upstream token refusal reached the client instead of being healed: ' + body).to.not.include(marker);

item.name: bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-luna streaming replay (pair A1, GPT consumer) - encrypted reasoning provider switch

exec: pm.test('pair A1 consumer stream completes without a replay error event', function () {
// Scan the events without extra_fields: raw_response echoes the provider wire (e.g. Bedrock reasoningContent) and is not a refusal.

try { var scanEvt = JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim()); delete scanEvt.extra_fields; if (scanEvt.response) { delete scanEvt.response.extra_fields; } return JSON.stringify(scanEvt); } catch (e) { return line; }
pm.expect(lower, 'an upstream token refusal reached the client instead of being healed: ' + body).to.not.include(marker);
return event.error || event.type === 'error' || event.type === 'response.failed' || event.type === 'response.incomplete' || (event.response && event.response.error);
var text = events.filter(function (event) { return event.type === 'response.output_text.delta'; }).map(function (event) { return event.delta || ''; }).join('');
